title: HV-Attack: Hierarchical Visual Attack for Multimodal Retrieval Augmented Generation
authors: Linyin Luo; Yujuan Ding; Yunshan Ma; Wenqi Fan; Hanjiang Lai
why_relevant: Proposes a visual adversarial attack on multimodal RAG that perturbs user query images to disrupt both retrieval and generation, directly relevant to adversarial robustness of RAG.
why_not_or_caveat: Focused on multimodal RAG attacks rather than general RAG robustness; no defense proposed.
